ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, April 18, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor students on Monday, April 25, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 350 is offered online in the summer and winter terms. No exceptions will be made. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
